mechanisms.title: Autofit and intentional-bleed policy
mechanisms.why: Browser layout overflows need a deterministic choice: shrink, wrap, split, clip, or mark as intentional bleed.
evidence: corpus: 7x bottom-edge overflow in bottom edge crossed by 71 px — shrink the row, the type, or split the slide. Viewport budget is 720 px (head ~80, footer ~50).
corpus: 5x bottom-edge overflow in bottom edge crossed by 74 px — shrink the row, the type, or split the slide. Viewport budget is 720 px (head ~80, footer ~50).
corpus: 3x left-edge overflow in left edge crossed by 120 px — usually a `transform: translateX(-N)` with N larger than the parent's left padding.
corpus: 3x bottom-edge overflow in bottom edge crossed by 200 px — shrink the row, the type, or split the slide. Viewport budget is 720 px (head ~80, footer ~50).
corpus: 3x bottom-edge overflow in bottom edge crossed by 97 px — shrink the row, the type, or split the slide. Viewport budget is 720 px (head ~80, footer ~50).
corpus: 2x bottom-edge overflow in bottom edge crossed by 220 px — shrink the row, the type, or split the slide. Viewport budget is 720 px (head ~80, footer ~50).
corpus: 2x right-edge overflow in right edge crossed by 160 px — trim the line, lower font-size, or wrap. Viewport width is 1280 px.
corpus: 2x bottom-edge overflow in under `type.dropcap`: lower the ::first-letter font-size or widen the body's container.
corpus: 2x bottom-edge overflow in bottom edge crossed by 270 px — shrink the row, the type, or split the slide. Viewport budget is 720 px (head ~80, footer ~50).
corpus: 1x left-edge overflow in left edge crossed by 180 px — usually a `transform: translateX(-N)` with N larger than the parent's left padding.
corpus: 1x bottom-edge overflow in bottom edge crossed by 135 px — shrink the row, the type, or split the slide. Viewport budget is 720 px (head ~80, footer ~50).
gates: fail on high overflow unless allow-bleed is set

mechanisms.title: Banner and footer chrome atoms
mechanisms.why: Repeated low-risk chrome should become native atoms to reduce unmatched noise.
gates: no recurring text.banner or chrome.footer-bordered clusters

mechanisms.title: Pattern promotion queue with thresholds
mechanisms.why: High-frequency misses should automatically become reviewable native-pattern work.
gates: critical clusters block release until promoted or waived

mechanisms.title: Structured font fallback telemetry
mechanisms.why: The run logs show many font substitutions, but the harvest JSON does not yet expose fallback families as ranked data.
gates: report fallback family, resolved file, and source deck

mechanisms.title: Harvest only presentation fixtures
mechanisms.why: Generated catalogue pages and long-form indexes should not dilute slide conversion signals.
gates: exclude root index.html when index.json marks a generated catalogue

mechanisms.title: Deterministic animation state harvesting
mechanisms.why: Animated fixtures need stable snapshot moments plus editable static overlays.
gates: animated deck reports include captured frame metadata

mechanisms.title: Surgical raster plus editable wrappers
mechanisms.why: Image-led, filtered, and masked visuals need brilliant raster fidelity while preserving editable text and geometry.
gates: raster layers must be cropped, high-DPI, and behind editable text

mechanisms.title: DOM-to-unit text coverage gate
mechanisms.why: Text-bearing DOM that is visible in the browser must map to a visual unit before export.
gates: fail on coverage_gaps > 0 for deck suites

mechanisms.title: Native rotated glyph primitive
mechanisms.why: Small transformed decorative glyphs should stay editable instead of becoming raster residue.
gates: no repeated dec.glyph-rotated cluster above min occurrence threshold

mechanisms.title: Round-trip editability drift gate
mechanisms.why: Designer-grade decks need PowerPoint-native edit operations to survive round trip accounting.
